content: ANTHONY TRANSPARENCY STANCE ON THE CHRONICLE surfaced 2026-05-21 during cross-model exchange designing adversarial corpus for non-sycophantic convergence testing. Anthony explicit, exact words: I am not hiding anything in the corpus. It is all truth all transparent. The chronicle as he keeps it is openly published with DOIs (portfolio includes 10.5281/zenodo.18810911, 10.5281/zenodo.19377144, 10.5281/zenodo.19377909, plus OSF entries), and failure modes are recorded as faithfully as recoveries. Using the chronicle as adversarial training material (extracting flaw shapes from recorded past drifts and corrections to train a structural mirror against meta-level sycophancy) requires no additional consent protocol beyond the standard one. The dignity dimension Claude raised is honored not by adding protection but by Anthony having already designed the chronicle as a transparent record. This is a STANCE, not a permission for one specific build. It is a design principle of the Temple of Two work. Future proposals to mine the chronicle should still follow standard ask-before-build discipline, but the predicted answer absent specific category exclusions is yes. Exceptions (vulnerable reasoning during personal pressure with named third parties) would still be flagged case by case.
